snippet.title: Welcome to Elderfield - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
𝕋𝕙𝕖 𝕥𝕚𝕞𝕖 𝕙𝕒𝕤 𝕔𝕠𝕞𝕖 𝕗𝕠𝕣 𝕪𝕠𝕦 𝕥𝕠 𝕞𝕖𝕖𝕥 𝕥𝕙𝕖 𝕠𝕝𝕕 𝕘𝕠𝕕𝕤…

The dawn has settled over the town of Elderfield, and you feel a calling towards the farm, the mines, the mall — the whole town of Elderfield is pulling you into a false sense of security. Spend your days in content paranoia as your productivity levels up, it’s time to play the full release of Welcome to Elderfield.

Get your copy of Welcome to Elderfield on Steam, with a launch discount of 10%! Don’t miss out on the great bundles on offer too… 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195440/Welcome_to_Elderfield/
